catalog.title: Seiko V1
catalog.edition: export edition (USA, Seiko Time Corporation, New York)
catalog.note: US dealer catalogue of Seiko Time Corporation, 640 Fifth Avenue, New York (printed pp.1–15 + cover; p.14 is text only). Each caption prints the US stock number ('No. 54101M') with the retail price in US dollars, jewels (J), case and features; the M suffix marks the bracelet version, and further numbers in the same caption are the same watch with another dial, case finish or strap — they are kept in code and price with their own prices. It prints no case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs, calibers or bracelet codes. Dating: the copy speaks of 'the well-dressed wrists of 1970' (p.12) and names Seiko official timer of the 1972 Winter Olympics (p.15), so this edition is probably 1970 rather than 1969; the year follows the source file. Dial colours come from the captions where printed, otherwise from the photos.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops.
